meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文档,把目录结构、常用命令与编码约定写清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常接手陌生代码库,想让 AI 助手一进项目就摸清结构。
copy.tagline_en: Write layered AGENTS.md so AI assistants learn a repo's structure and commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often pick up unfamiliar repos and want AI to know them fast.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描仓库，按目录复杂度给根目录和子目录分别写 AGENTS.md，记录结构、公开符号、命令、约定与反模式。默认最多三层，已有文件按更新模式改写。
howto.when: 当某个仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录给 agent 用时触发；在对话里调用 /init-deep，可加 --create-new 或 --max-depth=N。

say.text: /init-deep 给这个仓库生成 AGENTS.md 知识库
say.note: 按目录复杂度分层生成

say.text: /init-deep --create-new 先读旧的再从头重新生成

howto.what_en: After install, Claude scans the repo and writes hierarchical AGENTS.md files (root plus complexity-scored subdirectories) covering structure, symbols, commands, conventions, and anti-patterns, defaulting to three levels deep.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents; run /init-deep, optionally with --create-new or --max-depth=N.

say_en.text: /init-deep — build an AGENTS.md knowledge base for this repo
say_en.note: Writes layered files by directory complexity
